brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: A portable electronics organizer: a base
requirements.evidence: Hex base of 6 pieces: full bases at (0,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (-1,1), (-2,1), (-2,1 top row) plus half-w (-1,0) and half-n (0,1); configurator check_build ok, meshClash clear.
Three drop-in bins: hex-bin-full-div3 at (0,0), hex-bin-full-div2 at (0,-1) and hex-bin-full-div2 at (1,0). They drop into their cells and can be lifted out.
One drawer (drawer:0#0,1#cut, key s, classic) on the cut face of the half-n base at (0,1).
Handle at (-2,1,0) top, seated on the triangle of covers at (-1,0), (-1,1) and (-2,1). Its triangle is fully covered, so the configurator accepted it.
Compact footprint of a few hex cells with a handle; the configurator does not check weight or carrying load, and the drawer and bins are not latched shut. Not verified for load or real portability.
The configurator checks fit and collisions only; no material, strength or load properties were checked.

finish.summary: Built a hex-cluster electronics organizer: a base of hex pieces, three removable drop-in bins for small parts, one drawer on a half base, and a carry handle on a covered triangle. Open faces are capped and joints bolted where the configurator allowed. check_build is ok with meshClash clear and no issues. Material strength, weight and portability were not verified.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Grab handle
parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
